name: Beach Mayhem!
author: Pooja_27
description: It's a sunny day on beach, but an alien ship just landed and space bots have taken over and are destroying everything! You must gather courage and fight before it's too late! Kill all enemies, battle the bosses and loot special weapons from bosses and reach the objective area. Health is scarce, so beware! We are counting on you soldier! Also, fun side quest- Collect Lollipops scattered all around the map! There are a total 11 of them, how many can you find?
